sources.snippet: SmolVLA combines a compact pretrained VLM with an action expert trained using flow matching. Given multiple images and a language instruction, the model outputs chunks of robot actions. The model is pretrained on community-collected datasets spanning diverse tasks and behaviors before being evaluated in both simulated and real-world environments.
